ACCOUNT_LINK.TITLE: Connect an external platform
ACCOUNT_LINK.DESCRIPTION: Generate a one-time code so a platform you already use can connect to this {installationName} workspace. The code proves you control this workspace — nothing else is shared.
ACCOUNT_LINK.STEP_CODE: Generate a connection code below. It is shown once and expires in one hour.
ACCOUNT_LINK.STEP_PASTE: Paste it into the platform you are connecting from.
ACCOUNT_LINK.STEP_APPROVE: That platform's support team completes the connection. You will see the status change here.
ACCOUNT_LINK.SHOWN_ONCE: This code is shown only once. Generate a new one if you lose it.
ACCOUNT_LINK.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

STATUS.WAITING: Waiting for the code to be used.
STATUS.CLAIMED: The code has been used. The connection is being completed.
STATUS.EXPIRED: That code expired before it was used. Generate a new one.
STATUS.REVOKED: This connection was ended. Generate a new code to connect again.
